Progress from recognition to independent application, then to unfamiliar competition scenarios. Students should explain their choices, identify errors or misconceptions, and verify the result rather than relying on memorisation alone.
subtopics.worked_example: Worked example: complete a representative word puzzles task, identify the key rule, clue, language feature or performance criterion, then explain and verify the result.
subtopics.pitfall: Common pitfall: confusing a related term, form, interpretation or technique with the exact requirement of the task, or skipping verification after producing an answer or performance sample.
subtopics.mastery: Mastery: perform or solve an unfamiliar word puzzles task independently, explain the reasoning or technique, correct a plausible error, and verify the final result against the stated criteria.

subtopics.title: language challenge strategy
subtopics.teaching: Choose the appropriate Tamil language skill by identifying whether a challenge depends on grammar, vocabulary, literature, comprehension, or language reasoning.
subtopics.worked_example: A question asking for the best word in a sentence should first be read for context before comparing dictionary meanings.
subtopics.pitfall: Pitfall: selecting a familiar word without checking its grammatical and contextual fit.
subtopics.mastery: Identify the tested Tamil skill and apply a suitable solving method.

subtopics.title: meaning and context reasoning
subtopics.teaching: Use surrounding words, sentence structure, literary context, and semantic relationships to determine the intended meaning rather than relying on isolated translations.
subtopics.worked_example: When a Tamil word has multiple meanings, use the surrounding sentence to select the meaning that preserves the author's intended idea.
subtopics.pitfall: Pitfall: choosing the most common dictionary meaning when the passage clearly signals another sense.
subtopics.mastery: Justify a Tamil meaning using contextual evidence.

subtopics.title: language error detection
subtopics.teaching: Review spelling, grammatical agreement, word choice, sentence order, and usage systematically to locate the first language error.
subtopics.worked_example: If a sentence contains a tense mismatch, identify the time reference first and then check whether the verb form agrees with it.
subtopics.pitfall: Pitfall: correcting a stylistic preference when the actual issue is grammatical or spelling accuracy.
subtopics.mastery: Locate and explain a genuine Tamil language error and correct it.

subtopics.title: integrated Tamil challenges
subtopics.teaching: Combine vocabulary, grammar, literature, comprehension, Thirukkural, and language reasoning in unfamiliar question formats.
subtopics.worked_example: A passage-based challenge may require identifying its theme, interpreting a phrase, correcting a grammatical form, and selecting a related literary idea.
subtopics.pitfall: Pitfall: treating each clue independently when the passage provides evidence that connects the answers.
subtopics.mastery: Combine multiple Tamil language skills to solve an integrated challenge.

subtopics.title: Tamil championship round
subtopics.teaching: Practice timed mixed Tamil challenges with careful reading, evidence-based answers, revision of uncertain items, and final accuracy checks.
subtopics.worked_example: In a timed round, answer direct vocabulary and grammar items first, then return to longer literature and comprehension questions with the remaining time.
subtopics.pitfall: Pitfall: rushing literary questions and choosing answers from memory without rereading the relevant text.
subtopics.mastery: Complete a mixed Tamil challenge accurately under time pressure and support answers with textual or linguistic evidence.
